[\"auto\",\"en\",\"<pre><a i=0>私の引越し先は、マ: My next destination is determined by the breakfast my mom makes. Breaking the yolk of her fried egg takes me to Paris, drinking milk takes me to Kenya, and spreading butter on my toast takes me to New York. And so, dozens, hundreds of times, I ate my mom's breakfast and traveled the world. But even then, my mom's breakfast was the most delicious. This is the story of breakfast, which a lonely eleven-year-old girl, like a butterfly, arrives at at the end of a loop. *The following contains a summary of the ending* "I," who has been stuck in a loop where my next destination changes depending on the order in which I eat breakfast, realizes that every six months I return to the previous location, resetting all my relationships. I also despair at the fact that as an eleven-year-old girl, I have no power to change the world. I even spent hundreds of years devouring books to pass the time, but my lonely heart could not be filled. Eventually, searching for someone who needs me, "I" decide to go outside without eating breakfast, use the power of the loop to predict the future, and live as "God" in the underworld. "I" seek fleeting pleasure from people who worship me just for sharing what I know. However, disgusted, "I" become desperate and use the knowledge I've accumulated to help anti-government forces. As a result, war breaks out. Feeling uneasy about the slaughter unfolding before my eyes, "I" return home for the first time in a while, only to find my mother killed by government forces who have come after "I," the instigator of the war. The loop brings "I" back to before my mother's breakfast. "Where do you think we're moving to next?" my mother asks, and "I" cry without even eating breakfast, "I don't want to go anywhere, I want to stay with you, Mom." Then my mother tells me, "We're not moving anymore, we're going to live in this town." With the move cancelled, the loop is broken, and "I" can live as an ordinary girl. Having regained my normal life, "I" eat breakfast and reflect on the people I met in the loop and the new people I will meet in the future.
